name: paste-offload
description: A pasted block over the threshold is saved to ~/.claude/pastes/ and the prompt keeps only its head and the file's path, so a 400k-character debug dump is not re-read on every later step.

thresholdChars.title: Save pastes longer than
thresholdChars.description: A pasted block (or a whole prompt with no paste tags) longer than this many characters is saved to a file.

headLines.title: Lines kept in the prompt
headLines.description: How many leading lines of a saved paste stay in the prompt.
